description: JSON Schema for tailscale2otel's config.yaml. This schema covers SHAPE ONLY: field names, types, closed enums, and the numeric ranges internal/config/validate.go enforces unconditionally. It does NOT and CANNOT express cross-field rules — mutually exclusive keys (e.g. a value field and its *_file sibling), fields required only when another field takes a particular value, or relationships between two sections (e.g. tailscale.tailnet vs. tailnets:). Those are enforced only at runtime by Config.Validate(). Passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient: `tailscale2otel -validate` (or a normal startup) against the real config file is the authoritative pre-flight check.

token.description: gate the status page + pprof behind this token (set via TS2OTEL_ADMIN__AUTH__TOKEN); empty is allowed only on a loopback listen — on any other bind the status page + JSON APIs are REFUSED with 403 (/healthz and /readyz stay open)

token_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

enabled.description: run the admin HTTP server (probes + status page + optional pprof mount)

landing_page.description: serve the human status page at / and machine-readable /api/status.json

listen.description: serves /healthz, /readyz, and the status page. Loopback by default: the status page is REFUSED (403) on a network-reachable bind without admin.auth.token, so widen this only together with a token

status_refresh_interval.description: how often the status page re-polls /api/status.json (1s freshness ticker is independent)

cert_file.description: serve the admin listener over HTTPS instead of plain HTTP; set together with key_file (both-or-neither)

critical_threshold.description: status-page cardinality view flags a metric critically at/above this count (must be >= warning_threshold; <= metric_limit when set; 0 disables)

collapse_external.description: bucket unresolved IPs as external/unknown (keeps cardinality bounded)

destination_port.description: add destination.port to flow metrics. INERT under metrics_mode: rollup (raw modes only); dst.service below is the bounded stand-in and is always on

exit_node_attribution.description: emit bounded tailscale.exit_node.io/packets attributing exit traffic to the relaying node (bounded by exit-node count)

geo_dims.description: add source/destination geo.country.iso_code + geo.continent.code to flow METRICS (needs enrichment.geoip). Nearly free under metrics_mode: rollup (top-N bounded); on the RAW families it splits the single "external" series ~250 ways. ASN/city NEVER reach a metric; flow LOGS carry everything regardless

identity_dims.description: add per-flow tailscale.{src,dst}.{user,tags,os} to flow metrics, on BOTH families. REQUIRES node_dims (identity is node-derived, so without it identity becomes the only splitting dimension); flow LOGS always carry them

metrics_mode.description: rollup (bounded top-N, lowest cardinality) | all (raw per-connection) | both (≈2x series; summing double-counts)

node_dims.description: include src/dst device names on flow metrics (who talked to whom); off keeps totals but drops the per-peer breakdown and suppresses the unique.* gauges

rollup_top_n.description: rollup mode: busiest src/dst node pairs kept per flush; the rest fold into an __other__ series (0 = default 500)

source_port.description: add source.port to flow metrics. INERT under metrics_mode: rollup (raw modes only) — and the most expensive knob here, ephemeral ports are unbounded

label_value_sample_cap.description: distinct values retained per (metric,label) for the label-cardinality views; beyond it the label is capped and examples truncated (0 disables label capture)

metric_limit.description: hard per-metric series cap; beyond it the SDK collapses extras into otel_metric_overflow (0/negative = unlimited)

key.description: per-key expiry gauge (the expiry WARN log fires regardless)

subnet_route_rollup.description: emit per-CIDR tailscale.subnet_routes.routers redundancy gauge (one series per subnet CIDR); fleet exit/subnet counts emit regardless

warning_threshold.description: status-page cardinality view flags a metric at/above this active-series count (self-obs only; 0 disables)

file_path.description: used when store: file — mount a writable, persistent path here (the dir is auto-created). This default suits a CONTAINER (the image pre-seeds it for uid 65532); a native run that cannot write it falls back to the platform state dir (~/.local/state, ~/Library/Application Support, %LocalAppData%) and logs where it went. Set this explicitly and it is used as-is — an explicit path is never relocated.

store.description: file (persists window cursors across restarts; falls back to memory + WARN if the path isn't writable) | memory (RAM only; cold-starts from initial_lookback after a restart)

interval.description: ACL policy snapshot

validate.description: run the non-mutating POST /acl/validate (policy_file:read scope) each tick; set false to keep the client strictly GET-only

interval.description: poll only

max_object_wire_bytes.description: reject and quarantine one object requiring more than 64 MiB of GET response bytes

cache_ttl.description: how long a resolved name is cached (PTRs rarely change, so a long TTL keeps resolver load low)

enabled.description: off by default (can add ~one flow-metric series per external IP when on)

max_entries.description: PTR cache size bound (new external IPs beyond this are not resolved; ~150 bytes/entry)

negative_ttl.description: how long a failed lookup is remembered (suppresses retries)

enabled.description: keep a bounded, in-memory ring of recent audit/webhook events and serve /events; needs admin.enabled + admin.landing_page (no effect otherwise)

max_events.description: how many individual events /events can see (100–100000). A plain count, not a time span — oldest evicted first. Lost on restart — OTLP stays the system of record

capacity_profile.description: trade memory for fidelity on every per-bucket dimension + the raw-connection ring: compact (~half), default (unchanged), or expanded (~double). Fixed, hard-coded presets only — never a raw number

enabled.description: keep a bounded, in-memory picture of recent traffic and serve /flows; needs admin.enabled + admin.landing_page (no effect otherwise)

max_future_skew.description: local-view admission only: reject records further ahead of this process clock (0–1h); OTLP emission is unchanged

retention.description: how far back /flows can see, as one-minute buckets (1m–24h). Memory scales with this, and with the number of tailnets in multi-tailnet mode. Lost on restart — OTLP stays the system of record

batch_size.description: rows committed per write transaction (1–100000); must not exceed queue_size. Only takes effect once directory is set

directory.description: OPTIONAL, opt-in: a directory for the on-disk /flows backend (internal/flowstore/sqlitestore). Empty (default) is memory-only. Relative paths resolve against this config file, like ingress_wal.directory. Setting this writes flow rows, including user identities, to disk — they then survive restarts and land in backups

flush_interval.description: force a partial batch to disk on this timer (100ms–5m) so a quiet tailnet's last few rows do not sit in memory indefinitely. Only takes effect once directory is set

max_export_rows.description: cap on rows a single CSV/JSON export may read (100–1000000), so a large window cannot be materialized into memory in one request. Only takes effect once directory is set

max_rows.description: hard cap on retained rows (10000–1000000000), enforced independently of retention so a traffic flood cannot fill the disk before the next sweep. Only takes effect once directory is set

query_timeout.description: give up a single read against the store after this long (1s–5m) rather than hang the admin page. Only takes effect once directory is set

queue_size.description: bound on the write-behind queue between Record and the disk writer (64–1048576); a full queue drops and counts rather than blocking. Only takes effect once directory is set

retention.description: how far back the on-disk store keeps rows (1h–8760h/365d), independent of flows.retention which still only sizes the in-memory ring. Only takes effect once directory is set

sweep_interval.description: how often retention and the row cap are enforced (1m–24h). Only takes effect once directory is set

enabled.description: ACL edits, device approval and churn, key lifecycle, user role changes, DNS and tailnet settings — the curated audit-log subset. Needs collectors.auditlogs. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__CATEGORIES__CONFIG_CHANGE__ENABLED

rollup.description: highest-volume category: rolled up by default so a busy tailnet draws a timeline rather than a picket fence. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__CATEGORIES__CONFIG_CHANGE__ROLLUP

enabled.description: a node key or auth key entering its expiry warning window — the marker that explains a device count stepping down. Needs collectors.keys / collectors.devices. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__CATEGORIES__EXPIRY__ENABLED

rollup.description: a fresh deployment finds every currently-expiring key at once, and one summary beats fifty markers at the same instant. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__CATEGORIES__EXPIRY__ROLLUP

dashboard_uid.description: confine annotations to ONE dashboard. Empty (default) writes organization annotations, visible on every board and in Explore — which is the point of pushing them. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__DASHBOARD_UID

dedupe_retention.description: how long a published annotation's dedupe key is remembered, so a restart cannot republish it. Must comfortably exceed the longest source overlap window. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__DEDUPE_RETENTION

extra_tags.description: extra tags added to every annotation, e.g. [env:prod]. Every annotation already carries tailscale2otel, category:<c> and rule:<id>. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__EXTRA_TAGS

max_per_minute.description: token-bucket CEILING on annotations written per process. Overage is dropped and counted, never delayed — a marker arriving after the moment it explains is worse than absent. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__MAX_PER_MINUTE

queue_size.description: hand-off buffer between the collector goroutines and the single publisher. A full queue drops and counts rather than blocking collection. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__QUEUE_SIZE

rollup_interval.description: bucket width for rolled-up categories: one region annotation per interval per category per tailnet, instead of one marker per event. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__ROLLUP_INTERVAL

state_file.description: where the dedupe set persists. Empty = annotations.json beside checkpoint.file_path. Deliberately NOT inside the checkpoint file, which the window pollers rewrite every tick. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__STATE_FILE

token_file.description: path to a file holding the token (Docker/k8s secret mount). Value XOR file — setting both is a config error. TS2OTEL_GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS__TOKEN_FILE

free_text_details.description: audit old/new/details, target names, key descriptions, posture values

network_topology.description: route CIDRs + split-DNS domains + search paths

mutex_profile_fraction.description: runtime.SetMutexProfileFraction; on by default (applied only when pprof or pyroscope is enabled), 0 = disabled

enabled.description: mount net/http/pprof on the admin server (REQUIRES admin.enabled + admin.auth.token — heap dumps can expose in-memory secrets)

basic_auth_password.description: Grafana Cloud: a profiles:write access-policy token (..._BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD)

basic_auth_password_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

basic_auth_user.description: Grafana Cloud: the profiles instance ID (set via TS2OTEL_PROFILING__PYROSCOPE__BASIC_AUTH_USER)

enabled.description: governs the background poller only

interval.description: poll period; minimum 5s. Ignored when enabled is false

enabled.description: run the Pyroscope continuous-profiling push agent

headers.description: extra HTTP headers on every profile upload, e.g. { X-Api-Key: abc }; values are secrets and redact from status/logs. Reserved headers (Authorization, tenant) win over these

server_address.description: REQUIRED when enabled, e.g. http://pyroscope:4040 or https://profiles-prod-NNN.grafana.net

enabled.description: REQUIRES tracing.enabled AND profiling.pyroscope.enabled. CPU profiles ONLY — Go attaches pprof labels to CPU samples, so heap/mutex/block/goroutine profiles cannot carry span identity

tags.description: extra static labels merged onto every profile, e.g. { env: prod }

tailnet_label.description: off | hashed | name — whether continuous profiles carry a tailnet dimension. A tailnet name is a CUSTOMER identifier and profiles go to a different destination from metrics/logs, so this is opt-in and NOT covered by pii_filter. hashed = a stable 12-hex SHA-256 prefix (answers "which tenant is burning CPU" for an MSP without shipping the name; pseudonymous, not anonymous — a small name space is enumerable). Emitted only for a single configured tailnet; multi-tailnet gets no tag, since there is one profiler per process. TS2OTEL_PROFILING__PYROSCOPE__TAILNET_LABEL

tenant_id.description: X-Scope-OrgID for multi-tenant servers (leave empty for Grafana Cloud)

ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CA to trust for the profiles endpoint (private CA / self-signed gateway)

cert_file.description: client certificate for mTLS to the profiles endpoint; set together with key_file (both-or-neither)

insecure_skip_verify.description: keep TLS but skip server-certificate verification — a footgun; prefer ca_file

allow_unauthenticated.description: acknowledge serving /metrics with NO token on a network-reachable bind (e.g. in-cluster scraping behind a NetworkPolicy); a loopback bind never needs this

token.description: gate /metrics behind this token (Bearer or Basic password); empty + a network bind = REFUSED 403 unless allow_unauthenticated. Set via TS2OTEL_PROMETHEUS__AUTH__TOKEN

token_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

coalesce_gather.description: serve scrapes arriving during an in-flight gather from that same gather (helps HA scraper pairs; costs slight staleness)

enabled.description: run the Prometheus pull endpoint (GET /metrics) on its own listener, alongside OTLP push

listen.description: bind for /metrics (default :2112); keep distinct from admin.listen

max_requests_in_flight.description: cap concurrent /metrics gathers (excess gets 503); a Gather walks every series, so N slow scrapes cost N walks. 0 = unlimited

timeout.description: give up on a single /metrics gather after this long (503). 0 = no timeout; keep below the scraper's own timeout

cert_file.description: serve the Prometheus /metrics listener over HTTPS instead of plain HTTP; set together with key_file (both-or-neither)

client_auth.description: how hard to check the client cert: require_and_verify (default when client_ca_file set)|verify_if_given|require|request|none

client_ca_file.description: require scrapers to present a client certificate signed by this CA (mTLS); needs cert_file/key_file, composes with auth.token

attributes.description: custom Resource attributes, e.g. { deploy.team: platform }. Max 32 entries, 256-byte keys/values; reserved keys are refused. FILE-ONLY (maps aren't settable via env)

deployment_environment.description: deployment.environment.name — outside service.*, so it lands in target_info only and may vary per environment. TS2OTEL_RESOURCE__DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT

from_env.description: also read OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES / OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, filtered by the same rules. Off by default: it hands the ambient environment a channel onto a per-series label surface. TS2OTEL_RESOURCE__FROM_ENV

service_namespace.description: service.namespace — promoted to a job-adjacent LABEL on every series. Keep it low-cardinality and stable across deploys. TS2OTEL_RESOURCE__SERVICE_NAMESPACE

enabled.description: emit tailscale2otel.up, api.requests, runtime metrics, etc.

instance_id.description: service.instance.id resource attr; empty => host name. Set via env, e.g. TS2OTEL_SELF_OBSERVABILITY__INSTANCE_ID=$POD_NAME

auto_configure.description: on startup, register THIS receiver as the tailnet's log-streaming sink for BOTH log types (network/flow AND configuration/audit), OVERWRITING any existing sink for either; needs enabled + public_url + the log_streaming OAuth scope

decompress.description: auto | gzip | zstd | none — request body decompression

enabled.description: run the Splunk-HEC receiver to INGEST pushed logs (set the relevant collectors' source: stream)

listen.description: bind address for the Splunk-HEC-compatible receiver

max_body_bytes.description: cap on the DECOMPRESSED body; 0 = 64 MiB default, negative = unlimited (over-cap = 413); when ingress_wal.enabled this receiver must set a positive value <= 64 MiB

max_concurrent_requests.description: how many requests may buffer a body AT ONCE (max_body_bytes caps one body, this caps their sum); 0 = 4 default, negative = unlimited (over-limit = 503 + Retry-After)

path.description: HEC endpoint path Tailscale POSTs to

public_url.description: externally reachable receiver URL; REQUIRED only when auto_configure: true

cert_file.description: HTTPS cert (Tailscale requires HTTPS; a `tailscale cert` works for private endpoints)

token.description: shared secret; Tailscale sends HTTP Basic auth (base64 user:token), "Authorization: Splunk <token>" also accepted as a fallback (set via TS2OTEL_STREAMING__TOKEN); empty on a NON-loopback listen = every request REFUSED with 403 (empty is allowed only on a loopback bind)

token_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

apikey.description: personal API key (set via TS2OTEL_TAILSCALE__AUTH__APIKEY); used only when method: apikey — expires <=90d and is tied to its creator

apikey_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret — keep in env, not here (..._CLIENT_SECRET)

client_secret_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

scopes.description: least-privilege read scopes requested for the token

client_id.description: federated OAuth client ID from the Tailscale admin console (TS2OTEL_TAILSCALE__AUTH__WORKLOAD_IDENTITY__CLIENT_ID)

id_token_file.description: path to the OIDC ID token, e.g. a Kubernetes projected service-account token; re-read on every exchange (rotation-safe)

rate_limit.description: global requests/sec across ALL collectors (0 = unlimited)

max_attempts.description: total attempts per request (1 = no retry); exponential backoff between tries

timeout.description: per-attempt timeout (each retry attempt; a retried request may take longer, and long Retry-After waits are honored)

max_log_response_bytes.description: cap (32 MiB) on ONE flow-log/audit-log response body; ~12000 flow records per poll — shrink the collector's window instead of raising this if you hit it

max_response_bytes.description: cap (4 MiB) on ONE snapshot-endpoint response body before decoding; ~2400 devices at ~1.8 KiB each — raise it (and the container memory limit) on a bigger tailnet, these endpoints are not paginated

tailnet.description: "-" = the authenticated principal's default tailnet (works out of the box); or set your tailnet's name explicitly, e.g. "example.com"

enabled.description: emit spans. TS2OTEL_TRACING__ENABLED

remote_parent.description: how an INBOUND traceparent's sampled bit is treated by the stream/webhook receivers: trust (today's behavior) | ignore (the local sampler alone decides, so a sender cannot force sampling) | link (start a new local root trace and link the remote one). TS2OTEL_TRACING__REMOTE_PARENT

sampler_arg.description: sample ratio in [0,1] for the *traceidratio samplers (ignored otherwise). TS2OTEL_TRACING__SAMPLER_ARG

arg.description: ratio in [0,1] for the *traceidratio samplers. TS2OTEL_TRACING__SAMPLERS__SCRAPE__ARG

cache_ttl.description: how long a fetched "latest version" is cached before re-fetching (minimum 5m)

enabled.description: emit per-device tailscale.device.version_skew + fleet rollups (device client version vs latest Tailscale stable). Needs the devices collector.

outdated_minor_threshold.description: a device this many minor releases behind counts toward tailscale.devices.outdated

enabled.description: emit tailscale2otel.update_available (running build vs latest tailscale2otel GitHub release)

timeout.description: per-request timeout for the external version fetch

dedup_audit_events.description: best-effort: drop a webhook event already counted via the audit logs

enabled.description: run the receiver for real-time Tailscale webhook events

listen.description: bind address for the webhook receiver

max_body_bytes.description: cap on the raw body read before signature verification; 0 = 1 MiB default, negative = unlimited (over-cap = 413); when ingress_wal.enabled this receiver must set a positive value <= 64 MiB

max_concurrent_requests.description: how many requests may buffer a body AT ONCE, BEFORE the HMAC is checked (max_body_bytes caps one body, this caps their sum); 0 = 4 default, negative = unlimited (over-limit = 503 + Retry-After)

path.description: endpoint path Tailscale POSTs events to

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 verification secret (set via TS2OTEL_WEBHOOK__SECRET); empty is accepted only on loopback, otherwise every request is refused with 403 before body read

secret_file.description: read the value from this file instead (Docker secrets); set the value or the file, not both; content is whitespace-trimmed

cert_file.description: serve native HTTPS when paired with key_file; leave both empty behind an HTTPS reverse proxy

key_file.description: private key paired with cert_file; both paths are validated as readable at startup

tolerance.description: reject signed timestamps older than this (replay window); "0" disables the check
